arrangement.notes: Arrangement focuses on a hook-heavy energy profile with an aggressive mood, using sample-based layers including texture beds and one-shot hits. Channels are named using sample slicing technique terminology.

designer_intent.arrangement_focus: create an experimental aggressive trip hop arrangement emphasizing strong hooks using sample-based textures

sensei_drum.brief: Generate an aggressive drum pattern using sample slicing techniques and one-shot hits for rhythm foundation.

bass_generator.brief: Create a powerful low-end bass line using punchy sample slices to support the hook and the groove.

harmony_generator.brief: Design harmonic textures using layered sampled chord pads with sample-based arrangements.

melody_generator.brief: Develop hook-heavy melodic lines using fragmented samples and one-shot hits with an experimental approach.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee the arrangement structure and ensure energy profiles and mood match the aggressive trip hop, applying sample-based techniques throughout.

presetor.brief: Apply production presets to preserve sample-based textures and support aggressive mood.

songgps.brief: Guide section transitions and monitor energy curves aligned with the hook-heavy, experimental trip hop style.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare unprocessed channel audio for mixing with focus on clarity between sample layers and one-shot hits.
